name: Swift Shop for WooCommerce – Get to WooCommerce checkout faster with a  smooth and hassle-free experience
author: Cupid Chakma

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store into a seamless shopping experience with Swift Shop, the instant cart solution for your WooCommerce carts and checkout needs!

Swift Shop keeps your customers engaged with an instant pop-up cart, quick product views, and lightning-fast search—all without leaving the page.

The instant cart widget enables customers to browse and add items to their cart, resulting in a quicker and more seamless checkout process. This way, you reduce hurdles and abandoned carts, turning more shoppers into happy customers and boosting sales.

How Does The Plugin Work?
When buyers click on the shop widget, they can instantly see their cart and product details, no matter what page they’re browsing on your website. Customers can effortlessly add, edit, or remove items from their cart without ever leaving the page, ensuring a smooth and engaging shopping experience. It also lets buyers easily apply coupon codes, see their billing summary, and head straight to checkout, bypassing the standard WooCommerce cart page entirely.

Features

  • Add Products to Cart Without Reloading the Page: Buyers can effortlessly add products to their shopping cart without needing to refresh the page or leave where they are. This creates a smooth and uninterrupted shopping experience, helping them stay focused on browsing and reducing the chances of abandoned carts.
  • View Product Details Without Leaving the Current Page: When buyers click on the shop widget, they can easily see product details and even make purchases right from the page they’re on! This saves time and keeps customers engaged by allowing them to explore even more products without having to navigate away.
  • Smart Search Across the Entire Store: Finding products is simple, with a global search bar that works on any page. Buyers can quickly filter their searches by categories to locate exactly what they need in seconds, making the shopping process faster and more efficient.
  • Advanced Filtering Options: Customers can narrow down their product choices with filters for price range, categories, colors, and more. These dynamic filters update results instantly, saving time and making it easy to find the perfect product, even in stores with large inventories.
  • Billing Summary on the Same Tab: A real-time billing summary informs buyers of their product totals, taxes, discounts, and the final price. This transparent and constantly updated view helps reduce confusion and ensures a clear understanding of costs.
  • Update Shipping Address: Shoppers can update their shipping address directly from the cart. Changes are applied immediately, so they don’t have to navigate to the checkout page to make edits. It’s fast, simple, and hassle-free.
  • Apply Promo Codes: A dedicated section in the cart allows buyers to easily apply promo or coupon codes. Discounts are applied in real-time, and updated totals are displayed instantly. This feature makes it easy to see savings and encourages buyers to complete their purchases.
  • Responsive Floating Cart: The floating cart widget gives buyers instant access to their cart from anywhere on your site. It updates dynamically with the latest items and totals, allowing customers to view and manage their cart without interrupting their shopping journey.
  • View, Edit, or Remove Items from the Cart Quickly: From the shopping widget’s cart tab, buyers can easily view their selected items. They can adjust quantities or remove items with a single click. All changes are updated instantly, making cart management fast and frustration-free.
  • Multi-language and Localization Support: The multiple language support feature makes Swift Shop for WooCommerce ideal for stores targeting an international audience. It is fully compatible with WooCommerce language packs and allows for easy translation, ensuring a smooth user experience.
  • Optimized for Speed and Performance: This Shop Widget plugin leverages the power of REST API and React JS for lightning-fast cart updates and actions like adding or modifying items. These optimizations ensure your site runs smoothly, even with high traffic.
  • Mobile-Friendly Design: Swift Shop for WooCommerce is designed to work perfectly on any device. Whether shoppers are using a smartphone, tablet, or desktop, they’ll enjoy a seamless shopping experience.
  • Easy-to-Use Admin Settings: Store owners can easily customize the plugin using a simple and user-friendly settings panel. They can turn features on or off and adjust the appearance to perfectly match their shop’s style—and all without any technical skills required!
  • Quick Integration with Existing Themes: Swift Shop integrates smoothly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. There’s no need for coding, so you can set it up and start enhancing your store right away.
  • User-Friendly Product Display: The plugin’s simple and user-friendly design makes product views visually appealing. It keeps shoppers engaged and enhances their overall buying experience.
  • Lightweight and Secure: Swift Shop is designed to be extremely lightweight, ensuring it won’t slow down your website. It’s also built with secure coding practices to protect customer data and keep your store safe.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 license. See the full license at GPLv2 License.

Privacy Policy

Swift Shop For Woocommerce uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or greater
  • PHP 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL 5.0 or greater

We recommend your host supports:

  • PHP 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater

Installation Instructions

  1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Installer, or manually by extracting the zip file to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Once activated, navigate to the ‘Swift Shop For WooCommerce’ menu to configure the plugin settings.
  4. Note: WooCommerce must be installed and activated on your site, as this plugin depends on WooCommerce to function correctly.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce for this plugin to work?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to function, as it uses WooCommerce’s cart, and shop page system on the widget as a replacement.

Is this plugin compatible with all themes?

While the plugin should work with most themes, we recommend using it with themes optimized for WooCommerce for the best experience.

What is React.js, and why is it used in this plugin?

React.js is a JavaScript library used to create highly interactive and dynamic user interfaces. In this plugin, React powers the shopping cart widget, enabling real-time updates without page reloads, which enhances the user experience.

Can I customize the appearance of the Swift Shop widget?

Yes, the plugin offers a user-friendly settings panel that allows you to adjust the widget’s appearance to match your shop’s style without needing technical skills.

Does Swift Shop work with multi-language stores?

Absolutely! Swift Shop supports multiple languages and is fully compatible with WooCommerce language packs, making it suitable for international audiences.

What happens if a customer changes their shipping address in the cart?

When customers update their shipping address directly from the cart, the changes are applied instantly, ensuring accurate totals without the need to navigate to the checkout page.

How does the plugin handle coupon codes?

Buyers can easily apply promo or coupon codes directly in the cart. Discounts are calculated in real time, and updated totals are displayed immediately.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, Swift Shop is designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring that your site runs smoothly even with high traffic.
